items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: Mr. Abbott, who owned the paper, said, “if you ever become a newspaper boy

ctx.x: Did you actually record with it that day?

Yes. So that day that, well I’ll tell you it was the funniest story that happened, a funny incident. Louis asked me did I know anything about the instrument, and could I play it. But what happened was I looked the instrument over and the vibraphone, the one in the studio, the vibraphone, Louis asked me could I play something on it? And I said, “sure.” I had never played on a vibraphone in my life. But I was a brazen young kid, and I looked on the vibraphone and saw it had the same keyboard that the xylophone had.…
So you had a little head start when it came to the vibes.
